def test_direct_chat_private_but_oversight_is_audited(people):
    r, m, a, o = people["roaster"], people["manager"], people["admin"], people["owner"]
    cid = ok(r.post("/api/v1/comms/direct", json={"user_id": uid_of(o, "Demo Manager")}))["id"]

    other = ok(o.post("/api/v1/comms/direct", json={"user_id": uid_of(o, "Office Admin")}))["id"]
    ok(m.get(f"/api/v1/comms/conversations/{other}"), 403)

def test_record_thread_follows_record_access(people):
    r, m, o = people["roaster"], people["manager"], people["owner"]
    pid = ok(o.post("/api/v1/masters", json={"kind": "product", "name": "Thread Robusta", "nominal_kg": 50}))["id"]
    ok(r.post("/api/v1/inward", json={"source": "OTHER", "source_name": "Test", "product_id": pid, "bags": 2, "damaged": 0},
              headers={"X-Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())}))
    lot = next(x for x in ok(r.get("/api/v1/inventory")) if x["status"] == "RELEASED")
    roast = ok(r.post("/api/v1/roasts", json={"inputs": [{"lot_id": lot["id"], "kg": 20}], "output_kg": 17, "duration_min": 15},
                      headers={"X-Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())}))
    tid = ok(m.get(f"/api/v1/comms/record/roast/{roast['id']}"))["id"]
    ok(m.post(f"/api/v1/comms/conversations/{tid}/messages", json={"body": "Why 15% loss? Check the probe."}))
    # the roaster created the batch, so follows the thread automatically
    inbox = ok(r.get("/api/v1/comms/inbox"))
    thread = next(c for c in inbox["conversations"] if c["id"] == tid)
    assert thread["unread"] == 1 and thread["title"] == f"Roast batch #{roast['id']}"
    # remove the roaster's stock access: lot threads close to them too
    ok(r.get(f"/api/v1/comms/record/lot/{lot['id']}"))
    ok(o.post(f"/api/v1/admin/users/{uid_of(o, 'Roaster')}/grants", json={"perm_key": "inventory.view", "effect": "deny",
                                                                        "reason": "testing thread access"}))
    ok(r.get(f"/api/v1/comms/record/lot/{lot['id']}"), 403)

def test_quiet_hours_hold_normal_alerts(portal, people):
    o, m = people["owner"], people["manager"]
    # make every hour quiet: 0 → 23 (start > end wraps; start==end disables)
    ok(o.put("/api/v1/admin/settings", json={"quiet_start_hour": 0, "quiet_end_hour": 23}))
    con = sqlite3.connect(portal.config.DB_PATH)
    hour = con.execute("SELECT strftime('%H','now','+330 minutes')").fetchone()[0]
    con.close()
    ok(m.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={"title": "Night job", "assigned_to": uid_of(o, "Roaster")}))
    titles = [a["title"] for a in ok(people["roaster"].get("/api/v1/alerts"))]
    if int(hour) < 23:  # inside the quiet window
        assert "New work: Night job" not in titles

def test_transfer_shortage_is_recorded_not_hidden(people):
    o, r, m = people["owner"], people["roaster"], people["manager"]

def test_sale_deducts_coffee_and_chicory_and_blocks_oversell(people):
    o, r, m = people["owner"], people["roaster"], people["manager"]
    item, chic = setup_counter(o, r, m)
    k = key()
    sale = {"lines": [{"item_id": item, "weight_kg": 1}], "payments": [{"method": "CASH", "amount_paise": 80000}]}
    bill = ok(r.post("/api/v1/counter/sales", json=sale, headers=k))
    assert bill["bill_no"].startswith("CTR-") and bill["total_paise"] == 80000
    assert ok(r.post("/api/v1/counter/sales", json=sale, headers=k))["id"] == bill["id"]   # retry = same bill
    inv = ok(o.get("/api/v1/inventory"))
    ctr = [x for x in inv if x["location"] == "CTR-01"]
    assert round(sum(x["kg"] for x in ctr if x["stage"] == "ROASTED"), 3) == 9.3     # 10 − 0.7
    assert round(sum(x["kg"] for x in ctr if x["product_id"] == chic), 3) == 4.7    # 5 − 0.3
    # pay less than total → refused
    ok(r.post("/api/v1/counter/sales", json={"lines": [{"item_id": item, "weight_kg": 0.5}],
                                             "payments": [{"method": "CASH", "amount_paise": 30000}]}, headers=key()), 400)
    # more chicory than the counter holds → refused, nothing posted
    e = ok(r.post("/api/v1/counter/sales", json={"lines": [{"item_id": item, "weight_kg": 20}],
                                                 "payments": [{"method": "UPI", "amount_paise": 1600000}]}, headers=key()), 400)
    assert e["error"] == "NOT_ENOUGH_AT_COUNTER"
    assert ok(r.get("/api/v1/counter/sales"))["totals"]["bills"] == 1
    # split payment
    ok(r.post("/api/v1/counter/sales", json={"lines": [{"item_id": item, "weight_kg": 0.25}],
                                             "payments": [{"method": "CASH", "amount_paise": 10000},
                                                          {"method": "UPI", "amount_paise": 10000, "reference": "UPI-123"}]}, headers=key()))

def test_refund_maker_checker_and_manager_limit(people):

def test_receipt_quarantine_roasting_qc_and_idempotency(people):
    r, o = people["roaster"], people["owner"]
    pid = product(o, "Real Test Robusta", 50)
    k = key()
    body = {"source": "AUCTION", "source_name": "Test auction", "product_id": pid, "bags": 3, "damaged": 1}
    res = ok(r.post("/api/v1/inward", json=body, headers=k))
    assert res["nominal_kg"] == 150 and res["allocatable_kg"] == 100 and res["quarantine_kg"] == 50
    assert ok(r.post("/api/v1/inward", json=body, headers=k))["id"] == res["id"]
    assert len(ok(r.get("/api/v1/inward"))) == 1
    inv = ok(r.get("/api/v1/inventory"))
    sound = next(x for x in inv if x["status"] == "RELEASED")
    damaged = next(x for x in inv if x["status"] == "QUARANTINE")
    assert sound["kg"] == 100 and damaged["kg"] == 50
    b = {"inputs": [{"lot_id": damaged["id"], "kg": 10}], "output_kg": 9, "duration_min": 13}
    ok(r.post("/api/v1/roasts", json=b, headers=key()), 400)
    b["inputs"][0]["lot_id"] = sound["id"]
    rr = ok(r.post("/api/v1/roasts", json=b, headers=key()))
    assert rr["qc_status"] == "QC_HOLD" and rr["loss_pct"] == 10
    ok(r.post(f"/api/v1/qc/{rr['id']}/decision", json={"decision": "RELEASED", "note": "Approved batch"}), 403)
    ok(people["manager"].post(f"/api/v1/qc/{rr['id']}/decision",
                              json={"decision": "RELEASED", "note": "Approved batch"}), 403)
    ok(o.post(f"/api/v1/qc/{rr['id']}/decision", json={"decision": "RELEASED", "note": "Approved batch"}))

    ok(o.post(f"/api/v1/collections/{kid}/verify", json={"approve": True}))
    assert next(i for i in ok(o.get("/api/v1/receivables"))["invoices"] if i["id"] == inv1["id"])["status"] == "PAID"
